question: Which of the following functions does NOT fall under the jurisdiction of local bodies?
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Law and Order**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **nation's laws are made by the government, which also maintains peace and order.**
 
• In order to accomplish this, it divides the tasks and takes the required actions to bring about **peace and legality.**
 
• It maintains relations with foreign countries,** draughts laws periodically**, and amends them as necessary for** national progress.**
 
• The constitution calls for an elected** legislature** to draught laws. **Every law must be based on the constitution**. Legal precedent refers to judicial rulings that have effects that are **fundamentally comparable.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Public Health**

 
 
• **​**The **science of improving and preserving the health of people and their communities is known as public health**. In order to do this task, healthy lifestyles are encouraged,** illness and injury** interference are researched, as well as **infectious disease detection**, prevention, and response.
 
 
 
• **Sanitation**
 
 
• **​**Sanitation is the term used to describe the **public health conditions linked to clean, potable, and effective handling of human waste and sewage disposal.**
 
 
 
• **Registration of Births and Deaths**
 
 
• **​**Between **decennial censuses**, **population movements** are tracked using** birth and death** registration data, which is supplemented with **migration statistics** (immigration and emigration). Worldwide, two-thirds of deaths and one-third of births are not officially documented.
 
 

b5:T
